subject: vt-dy
title: (R)VT. DY.------ POST.
description: Pedagogical example schematic from the Glossary Integration / CODE section (book pp 13–14), where Braxton teaches the reader how to read his integration charts. The arrow points to VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) marking it as the schematic's subject; the bracketed (R) prefix signals 'the reality of' that subject; the dashed line to POST (postulation) signals the relational concept the subject is being read against. Three branches expand the subject: (1) source initiation SI, opening into primary vibrational tendencies PRI-VT-TD; (2) reality alignment RT-ALGN, opening into language dynamics LANG-DY; (3) affinity tendencies AFTD, opening into individual dynamics INDIV-DY which itself branches into affinity insight AFI and progressional continuance PROG-CONT. The diagram thus instantiates Braxton's broader claim — articulated on pp 13–14 — that no concept in the Tri-Axium system can be read in only one context: a schematic 'should be viewed as axiom tenets', forcing the reader to hold the subject's vibrational, reality-alignment, and affinity-tendency aspects together.
